thesis: The speakers argue that science is driven by real-world experiments and that their company, Periodic Labs, aims to build an AI physicist by tightly coupling large language models and simulations with physical experiments to create a physically grounded reward function. They contend that while previous AI models like ChatGPT were optimized against human preferences, the next frontier involves using nature itself as the environment for reinforcement learning to accelerate physical R&D in areas like advanced manufacturing, material science, and chemistry.
